notes: A term marked ordinary is a command or an adjective that is also an everyday word (Close, Open, Done, Play, Next, Add, Delete, ...). It is found only as a whole label (Close, Open...) or in a title-case phrase (Close Window, Open %@ in TextMouth), which is how a menu item or a button is written, so a sentence such as close to the end is not a use of Close. Nouns (Library, Bookmark, Chapter) are found anywhere, in any case.
A term is never found inside a do-not-translate name: Windows-1252 is the name Windows, not the term Window.
